An Iron Heart Part I#001.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#001.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#002.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#002.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#003.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#003.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#004.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#004.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#005.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#005.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#006.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#006.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#017.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#017.speaker: Duvale
